extension.description: Configurable text highlights, live styles and English/Chinese UI. Based on ryu1kn/vscode-text-marker.
configuration.title: Text Marker settings
setting.highlightColors: Palette for new highlights and cycling existing highlight colors. New highlights prefer unused colors; cycling follows this order and wraps to the first color.
setting.defaultHighlightColor: Color used after all colors in textmarker.highlightColors are in use.
setting.defaultHighlightOpacity: Background opacity from 0 (transparent) to 1 (opaque), unless the color specifies its own opacity.
setting.enableIgnoreCase: Ignore case when the extension starts.
setting.enableWholeMatch: Match whole words when the extension starts.
setting.useHighlightColorOnRuler: Use each highlight color on the overview ruler.
setting.autoSelectDistinctiveTextColor: Choose text colors that contrast with the highlight background, overriding syntax colors.
setting.hideStatusBarItems: Hide the matching mode buttons on the status bar.
setting.delayForRefreshingHighlight: Delay in milliseconds before refreshing highlights after edits. Set to null to disable refresh.
setting.commandsOnContextMenu: Choose which commands appear on the editor context menu. The toggleHighlight option controls the Set Highlight submenu.
setting.savedHighlights: Saved highlights to restore when opening an editor.
setting.borderWidth: Highlight border width in pixels. Set to 0 to hide the border.
setting.borderStyle: Highlight border style. The border uses the highlight color.
setting.borderRadius: Highlight corner radius in pixels. Use 0 for square corners or 999 for a pill shape.
